description: This file defines the CardFilter class with static methods for filtering Card objects based on various filter groups and clauses, including date handling and property matching.

classes.name: CardFilter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for filtering Card objects based on complex filter groups and clauses.

methods.name: createDatePropertyFromString
methods.description: Creates a DateProperty object from a string, parsing JSON or converting a timestamp.

methods.name: applyFilterGroup
methods.description: Filters an array of Card objects based on a filter group.

methods.name: isFilterGroupMet
methods.description: Checks if a Card meets the criteria of a filter group.

methods.name: isClauseMet
methods.description: Determines if a Card satisfies a specific filter clause.

methods.name: propertiesThatMeetFilterGroup
methods.description: Returns properties that meet the criteria of a filter group.

methods.name: propertyThatMeetsFilterClause
methods.description: Returns property id and value if a filter clause is met for a property.
